title: Evaluation of the complete decision tree
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\alpha$ be a type, and let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\alpha$. The complete decision tree constructed from $f$, which queries all coordinates, evaluates to $f$; that is, its evaluation as a function on the Boolean cube equals $f$.
hypotheses_covered: function f from the Boolean cube to α
